[[File:Soren Rocko.png|thumb|250px|Soren (left) and Rocko (right)]] '''Soren''' (Japanese: '''ソラン''' ''Soran'') and '''Rocko''' (Japanese: '''リーク''' ''Rīku'') are [[Character of the day|characters of the day]] who appeared in ''[[BW099|A Surface to Air Tag Battle Team!]]''. They are twin brothers, with Soren being the elder one. Soren claims to be "master of the sky", whereas Rocko is the "master of the ground". They have been shown to have great teamwork in their [[Multi Battle|Tag Battle]]s. However, as with all siblings, they often get into fights if something goes wrong; in this case, losing a battle. Apparently, they do not wish to compete in the [[Pokémon League]] because they only participate in Tag Battles. While walking through a field during their journey, {{Ash}}, {{an|Iris}}, and {{an|Cilan}} were confronted by a {{p|Drilbur}} and a {{p|Braviary}}. These belonged to Soren and Rocko, who revealed themselves from their hiding place. After their introduction, they challenged {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} to a Tag Battle, claiming they were the greatest Tag-Battling brothers in the {{pkmn|world}}. Soren even said they easily defeated the Subway Bosses, [[Emmet]] and [[Ingo]], though Rocko revealed that was merely in their fantasy. Soren and Rocko were excited to hear Cilan is a [[Gym Leader]] and so they wanted to battle against him and Ash. While Soren and Rocko chose Braviary and Drilbur to battle, Ash and Cilan decided to go with {{AP|Unfezant}} and {{TP|Cilan|Pansage}}. At first, Ash and Cilan were surprised by the brother's unique combinations, but after taking some hits, they countered with their own combinations and eventually won. This loss made the brothers upset, and they started to blame it on each other's Pokémon. Cilan gave them a {{pkmn|Connoisseur}} evaluation and that the brothers needed to catch a {{type|Water}} Pokémon to battle perfectly because then they would have full coverage over land, sky, and water. Cilan and the brothers went [[fishing]]. They soon hooked a pair of male and a female {{p|Frillish}}, however, the brothers' fighting allowed the Pokémon to swim off. Shortly after that, a {{p|Buizel}} and {{p|Corphish}} appeared. This time, the brothers worked together perfectly, even deciding who would catch which Pokémon. Soren managed to catch Buizel, while Rocko succeeded in catching Corphish.
